servers.name: fetch
servers._comment: mcp-server-fetch's mcp dependency is unpinned and uv resolves it to the newer mcp 2.0.0 release, which renamed MCPError and breaks it (ImportError) — pin below 2.0.0 until upstream fixes this.

servers.name: git
servers._comment: Same mcp<2.0.0 pin as fetch — same upstream break. No -r/--repository flag: every tool takes repo_path as a per-call argument, so it's multi-repo capable.
